questions.question: Provida style of architecture belongs to which empire?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the**__ Vijayanagar Empire__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Provida style of architecture belongs to the Vijayanagar Empire, which was a South Indian empire that ruled from the 14th to 17th century.**
 
• This style of architecture is characterized by intricate carvings, sculptures, and ornamental details on pillars, walls, and ceilings of temples and palaces.
 
• The Vijayanagar Empire was known for its patronage of art and architecture, and the Provida style was one of the many styles that flourished during this time.
 
• The Vijayanagar rulers were great builders. During this period, palaces, temples, huge halls (maha mandapa), forts, towers, public buildings, dams, tanks, and canals were constructed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The Bahmani Empire**, on the other hand, was a Muslim kingdom that ruled parts of South India from the 14th to 16th century, and its architecture was influenced by Persian and Islamic styles.
 
• **The Mauryan Empire **was an ancient Indian empire that existed from the 4th to 2nd century BCE, and its architecture is known for its monumental pillars, rock-cut caves, and stupas.
 
• ** The Gupta Empir**e was another ancient Indian empire that existed from the 4th to 6th century CE, and its architecture is known for its temple complexes, sculptures, and paintings.

questions.question: By which process, water soluble inorganic nutrients go down into the soil horizon and get precipitated as unavailable salts?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Leaching.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leaching is the process by which water-soluble inorganic nutrients present in the topsoil get washed down into the lower soil horizons and get precipitated as unavailable salts.**
 
• This process occurs due to** excessive rainfall or irrigation,** which causes the excess water to percolate through the soil and carry the nutrients with it.
 
• The nutrients that are commonly leached from the topsoil include nitrates, phosphates, and potassium, which are essential for plant growth.
 
• However, when they accumulate in the lower soil horizons as salts, they become unavailable to plants and can even cause soil salinization if the concentration becomes too high.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ** Fragmentation:** It refers to the breakdown of organic matter into smaller particles by physical or biological processes. It does not directly affect the leaching of nutrients.
 
• ** Humification**: It is the process of decomposition of organic matter into humus, which is a stable form of organic matter that improves soil fertility. It does not directly affec**t the leaching of nutrients.**
 
• Decomposition: It refers to the breakdown of organic matter into simpler compounds by microorganisms. It can release nutrients into the soil, but it does not directly affect the leaching of nutrients.

questions.question: Who wrote book named "Gulamgiri" in 1873?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Jyotiba Phule.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gulamgiri is a masterpiece in itself.
 
• It is regarded as the very first book that talked about the caste system and how certain castes were exploited during that time.
 
• It was written in 1873.
 
• It was written in the form of a dialogue.
 
• The book is written in the form of a dialogue between Jyotiba and a character called Dhondiba.
 
• Jyotiba dedicated his book to the American slaves.
 
• The black Americans were treated as slaves and were highly discriminated against because of their dark complexion.
 
• He linked the condition of the blacks with the condition of the lower castes in India.​

​Thus, Jyotirao Phule was the writer of the book 'Gulamgiri'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Jyotirao Phule ​​

 
 
• Jyotirao Phule was a social activist and a social reformer.
 
• He was born in 1827.
 
• He was the first writer to write against the caste system.
 
• He tried his best to remove prejudice and untouchability from the caste system.
 
• He tried to bring out the injustices done to the lower castes and how they were treated as slaves just because they belonged to a lower caste.

questions.question: The minimum rate below which banks are not allowed to lend money except in cases specified by the Reserve Bank of India is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**base rate.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Base Rate is the minimum interest rate of a bank below which it cannot lend, except in some cases allowed by the RBI.
 
• It is the minimum interest rate of a bank below which it is not viable to lend.
 
• The base rate, introduced with effect from 1st July 2011 by the Reserve Bank of India, is the new benchmark rate for the lending operations of banks.
 
• Thus all categories of domestic rupee loans should be priced only with reference to the Base Rate, subject to the conditions mentioned in RBI circulars dated April 9, 2010 and January 19, 2015.
 
• The reason for introducing Base Rate was to bring out the transparency in bank lending rates as well as to improve monetary policy transmission.
 
• Since the Base Rate will be the minimum rate for all loans, banks are not permitted to resort to any lending below the Base Rate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Reverse Repo Rate:** It is the rate at which the RBI borrows money from commercial banks. It is used as a tool to control the money supply in the economy.
 
• **Repo Rate:** It is the rate at which the RBI lends money to commercial banks. It is also used to control the money supply and inflation.
 
• **Cash Rate:** This term is not relevant to India as it is used to refer to the interest rate set by the Reserve Bank of Australia.

questions.question: Which among the following dance forms of India is associated with Rajasthan?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Ghoomar is a traditional dance form of Rajasthan and is usually performed by women during special occasions and festivals.**
 
• The dance involves graceful movements**, twirls, and spins while the dancers wear colorful traditional attire and jewelry.**
 
• Charkula is another dance form of Rajasthan that involves balancing a large number of lighted lamps on the head while dancing.
 
• Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu and is known for its intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions.
 
• Odissi is another classical dance form that originated in Odisha and is known for its fluidity and gracefulness in movements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the most popular classical dance forms of India and is known for its spiritual and devotional themes.
 
• Odissi, on the other hand, is a blend of music, dance, and drama and is known for its storytelling aspect.
 
• Charkula is a unique dance form that is mostly performed in the Braj region of Uttar Pradesh and involves balancing a pyramid of lit-up brass pots on the head while dancing.
 
• Overall, each of these dance forms represents the rich cultural heritage of India and is a symbol of its diversity and traditions.

questions.question: How many laws were repealed under the Farm Laws Repeal Bill, 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Three.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On November 29, 2021, Mr. Narendra Singh Tomar, the Minister of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, introduced the Agricultural Laws Repeal Bill, 2021 in the Lok Sabha.
 
• Three farm laws passed by Parliament in September 2020 are repealed by the Bill.
 
• These include
 
 
• the Farmers (Empowerment and Protection) Agreement on Price Assurance and Agricultural Services Act,
 
• the Farmers' Produce Trade and Commerce (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, and
 
• the Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, all of which are slated to take effect in 2020.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• These laws were passed in order to:

 
 
• provide a framework for contract farming;
 
• make it easier for farmers to sell their produce outside of markets that have been notified under the various state Agricultural Produce Marketing Committee (APMC) laws; and
 
• limit the availability of some foods (like cereals, pulses, and onions) to times of extreme need, such as war, famine, or an unusual price increase.

• It is the **seventh-largest desert in the world** and covers an area of approximately 200,000 square kilometers.
 
• The Thar Desert is characterized by its arid climate, sand dunes, and extreme temperatures.
 
• The other options given in the question are not correct. The Coastal Plains are located along the coastlines of India, the Northern Plain is located in the northern part of India, and the Eastern Ghats are a mountain range located in the eastern part of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The Rann of Kutch is known for its unique landscape, wildlife, and cultural heritage.
 
• It is home to several species of migratory birds, such as flamingos, and is also a popular tourist destination.

questions.question: Formula to find unemployment rate is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** (Unemployed workers/Total labor force) × 100.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

Unemployment refers to a situation where a person actively searches for a job and is unable to find work.

Unemployment rate = (Unemployed Workers/ Total Workforce) x 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/292e0c96dd6c006ce1f3ef21b86308c7c73a2bc69f508d641b46f352d114f429.png] __Important Points__ Methods/ measures for estimating unemployment:

Usual status unemployment:

 
• This measure estimates the number of persons who remained unemployed for a major part of the year.
 
• This measure gives the lowest estimates of unemployment.

Current weekly status:

 
• The estimate measures unemployment with respect to one week.
 
• A person is said to be unemployed if he is not able to work even for an hour during the survey period.

Current daily status:

 
• If a person does not find work on a day or some days during the survey week, he is regarded as unemployed.
 
• The daily status is considered to be a comprehensive measure of unemployment.

questions.question: Mohenjodaro belongs to which of the following civilization?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the__** Indus Valley civilization.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohenjodaro belongs to the Indus Valley civilization, which was one of the earliest civilizations in the world.**
 
• The Indus Valley civilization flourished in the northwestern regions of South Asia, including parts of present-day India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan.
 
• Mohenjodaro was one of the largest cities of the Indus Valley civilization, with a well-planned layout, sophisticated drainage system, and impressive architecture.
 
• The civilization is known for its advanced urban planning, trade, agriculture, and use of symbols and writing systems.
 
• Mohenjo-Daro was one of the most important sites of Harappan city.
 
• Mohenjo Daro signified the “Mound of the dead” and Mohenjo Daro was referred best the known Indus site.
 
• It is situated in Sindh, Pakistan, next to the Indus River.
 
• Mohenjo-Daro was discovered in 1922 by R. D. Banerji, an officer in the Archaeological Survey of India, two years after the major excavations that began at Harappa, some 590 km to the north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Maya civilization was a Mesoamerican civilization that flourished in present-day Mexico, Guatemala, Belize, and Honduras.
 
• Egyptian civilization was an ancient civilization that developed along the Nile River in northeastern Africa.
 
• Mesopotamian civilization was an ancient civilization that developed in the region of present-day Iraq, Kuwait, and Syria.

questions.question: Which of the following government official is the ex officio chairman of Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Vice President.__

The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

__
 
• The post of Vice-President of India is displayed on the lines of American Vice-President. In India, the vice- president has the second-most elevated office in the country.
 
• Article 63 of the Indian Constitution specifies the post of Vice-President.
 
• Jagdeep Dhankhar (As of September 2022) is the current Vice President of India and the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha. 
 
• The Vice–President attends the role of President in his absence (Article 65).
 
• Dr. Sarvpalli Radhakrishanan was the first Vice President of India who served from 1952 till 1962. 

Important Articles related to Vice–President:

 
• Article 66 – Election of Vice–President
 
• Article 69 – Oath to Vice–President and administered by President

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39997ab25e68a0037d9b6e6fc32720c9844f92b075aa45bd0314bdc2cbc8713d.png] Mistake Points__

 
• In the absence of the vice–president, no one attends his duties but the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha acts as the Chairman of Rajya Sabha. 
 
• There is no salary of Vice–President in the Indian constitution but he gets a salary for his term as Ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: The force exerted by a charged body on another charged or uncharged body is known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Electrostatic force.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Electrostatic force is the force between two charges it is also a central force because it acts along the line joining the centers of the two charges.
 
• It is also known as coulombian or electric force sometimes.
 
• Lightning is an example of electrostatic forces in everyday life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pressure force**, on the other hand, is the force exerted by a fluid on a surface. It depends on the pressure, area, and orientation of the surface.
 
• **Gravitational force** is the force of attraction between two objects due to their masses. It is proportional to the product of the masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them.
 
• **The frictional force** is the force that opposes the motion of an object when it comes into contact with another object or surface. It depends on the nature of the surfaces and the force pressing them together.

questions.question: Liver gland secretes ________ that is stored in a sac called the gall bladder.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __liver__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bile is secreted by the liver.

 
 
• Bile is a fluid that is made and released by the liver and stored in the gallbladder.
 
• Bile helps with digestion.
 
• It breaks down fats into fatty acids, which can be taken into the body by the digestive tract.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mucous is a viscous secretion** that is produced by mucous membranes, and it helps in lubricating and protecting the tissues. It is not secreted by the liver gland.
 
• **Hydrochloric acid** is a strong acid that is secreted by the stomach lining, and it helps in the breakdown of food particles. It is not secreted by the liver gland.
 
• **Estrogen is a hormone** that is produced by the ovaries in females, and it plays a vital role in the development of secondary sexual characteristics. It is not secreted by the liver gland.

questions.question: In 2019, the Government of India honoured Milena Salvini, an Italian - born Kathakali dancer, with which of the following award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Padma Shri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ Milena Salvini

__
 
• She was an Italian-born French exponent and teacher of Indian classical dance. 
 
• She was a famous Kathakali dancer and had established a dance school named 'Centre Mandapa' in Paris. 
 
• Kathakali dancer Milena Salvini of France passed away in January 2022.
 
• She was conferred with Padma Shri in 2019 by the Government of India for her contribution to the field of performing arts.
 
• In 1962, Salvini obtained a two-year scholarship to train in Kathakali at the Kerala Kalamandalam

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian **award in India, given for distinguished service in various fields such as art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, and civil service.
 
• Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award in India, while Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan are the second and third highest civilian awards, respectively.
 
• **Bharat Ratna **is awarded for exceptional service towards advancement of art, literature and science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order. Padma Vibhushan is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field, while Padma Bhushan is awarded for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• **Milena Salvini **is a renowned Kathakali dancer who has been promoting the art form in India and abroad for over 30 years. She has also trained several Indian and foreign students in Kathakali.

questions.question: Super Bowl, an annual championship game of Football is held in ________ Country.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the__** United States of America.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Super Bowl is an annual championship game of American Football, and it is one of the most-watched television broadcasts in the United States.**
 
• The first Super Bowl was played in 1967, and since then, it has been held annually on the first Sunday in February.
 
• The Super Bowl is not only a football game, but it is also a cultural event that includes halftime shows, commercials, and parties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Super Bowl is the culmination of the National Football League (NFL) season, and it is played between the champions of the league's two conferences, the American Football Conference (AFC) and the National Football Conference (NFC).
